products.name: Residential Solar System Sales and Installation
products.description: Designs, sells, and installs complete solar energy systems for residential homeowners, including system design, permitting, installation, and customer support. Delivery requires in-person labor, project management, and coordination with local construction specialists or in-house teams.

products.name: Solar System Sales and Installation for Home Builders and New Home Communities
products.description: Provides solar energy systems to home builders and new home communities, including system design, installation, and integration into new construction projects. Delivery involves coordination with builders and construction partners.

products.name: Commercial Solar System Sales and Installation (Small to Medium-Sized Businesses)
products.description: Designs, sells, and installs solar energy systems for small to medium-sized commercial customers, including system customization and installation. Delivery requires project management and construction expertise.

products.name: Battery Storage Solutions
products.description: Offers battery storage systems as an add-on to solar installations, enabling customers to store excess solar energy for later use. Delivery involves physical installation and integration with solar systems, often in partnership with third-party battery providers.

products.name: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Installation
products.description: Provides installation of electric vehicle charging stations as an additional service to solar customers. Delivery requires physical installation at customer premises, often bundled with solar system sales.

products.name: Solar Energy Sales Partner Platform and Services
products.description: Provides a technology platform, software tools, and sales support services to third-party sales partners and builder partners, enabling them to sell and manage solar projects under the company’s brand. Delivery is digital and service-based, supporting external partners’ sales and project management.

products.name: New Commercial Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of new commercial vehicles, including heavy-duty, medium-duty, and light-duty trucks, as well as buses, manufactured by brands such as Peterbilt, International, Hino, Ford, Isuzu, IC Bus, Blue Bird, Blue Arc, and Battle Motors. Vehicles are sold through physical dealerships and require inventory management, manufacturer relationships, and regulated franchise agreements.

products.name: Used Commercial Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of used commercial vehicles and trailers, sourced from trade-ins, retired lease/rental fleets, or third-party purchases, reconditioned for resale through dealership service and collision centers. Delivered via physical locations and inventory management systems.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts Sales
products.description: Sale of a wide variety of commercial vehicle parts and proprietary accessories through dealership locations and specialized stores. Requires inventory management, supplier relationships, and distribution logistics.

products.name: Service, Maintenance, and Collision Repair
products.description: Provision of warranty and non-warranty repairs, collision repairs, full-service maintenance contracts, and mobile service for commercial vehicles at dealership locations and customer sites. Delivered by skilled technicians using physical facilities and mobile units.

products.name: Vehicle Leasing and Rental
products.description: Leasing and rental of commercial vehicles, including trucks, cranes, and refuse vehicles, on daily, monthly, or long-term contracts, often bundled with full-service maintenance. Managed through dedicated leasing locations and fleet management systems.

products.name: Commercial Vehicle Financing
products.description: Arrangement of third-party financing for new and used commercial vehicle purchases, including installment contracts and trade-in management. Delivered through dealership finance departments and external financial partners.

products.name: Commercial Vehicle Insurance Products
products.description: Sale, as an agent, of property and casualty insurance products for commercial vehicles, including liability, collision, cargo, and credit life insurance. Delivered through licensed insurance agency operations at dealership and stand-alone locations.

products.name: Vehicle Upfitting and Customization
products.description: Installation of specialized equipment, body and chassis modifications, natural gas fuel system installations, and component installations for commercial vehicles. Delivered through specialized facilities and skilled labor, often for oilfield and other specialized service providers.

products.name: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) Fuel Systems
products.description: Manufacture and sale of compressed natural gas fuel systems and related component parts for commercial vehicles, through a joint venture with Cummins. Requires physical manufacturing and distribution to commercial vehicle customers.

products.name: Vehicle Telematics and Technology Solutions
products.description: Provision of vehicle telematics products and technology solutions to maximize fleet performance, including support and integration with commercial vehicles. Delivered digitally and through dealership support.

products.name: Digital Media Content Publishing
products.description: Production and distribution of digital editorial content across sports, finance, and lifestyle verticals via owned and operated brands, leveraging a proprietary publishing platform and a network of expert contributors. Content is delivered digitally and monetized primarily through advertising and audience engagement.

products.name: Platform Services for Publisher Partners
products.description: Provision of a proprietary online publishing platform and monetization tools to independent third-party publishers, enabling them to produce, manage, and monetize editorial content through technology infrastructure, advertising solutions, and data analytics. Delivered as a digital SaaS-like service.

products.name: Advertising and Monetization Solutions
products.description: Offering proprietary advertising technology and monetization solutions, including programmatic advertising, yield optimization, and data-driven audience targeting, to both owned brands and Publisher Partners. Delivered digitally and reliant on proprietary data and technology.

products.name: E-commerce and Social Selling
products.description: Integration of e-commerce capabilities, including affiliate marketing, digital commerce, and live/social selling, to monetize audiences through direct consumer spend. Includes operation of ShopHQ as a digital-first, dropship-focused marketplace leveraging creator-led commerce.

products.name: Asset-Based Dry Van Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of nationwide short, medium, and long-haul truckload freight transportation using company-owned tractors and trailers, primarily for non-perishable goods, delivered directly from origin to destination. Requires significant physical assets, experienced drivers, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Cross-Border Freight Transportation Services (U.S.-Mexico)
products.description: Cross-border truckload freight transportation services between the United States and Mexico, utilizing third-party partnerships and company assets, with operations under the CFI brand in Mexico. Involves regulatory compliance and coordination with Mexican entities.

products.name: Temperature-Controlled Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of truckload transportation for temperature-sensitive freight using specialized refrigerated equipment. Requires investment in temperature-controlled trailers and compliance with food safety regulations.

products.name: Tovorafenib (OJEMDA)
products.description: An oral, brain-penetrant, highly selective type II RAF kinase inhibitor developed and commercialized as OJEMDA for the treatment of pediatric low-grade glioma (pLGG) and other RAF-altered tumors. Manufactured via third-party contract organizations and delivered as tablets or oral suspension for chronic administration.

products.name: Emiltatug Ledadotin (Emi-Le)
products.description: A B7-H4-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with a site-specific auristatin payload, intended for the treatment of advanced solid tumors, including adenoid cystic carcinoma (ACC) and other cancers. Manufactured using proprietary linker-payload technology and delivered intravenously in clinical trials.

products.name: DAY301
products.description: A PTK7-targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) composed of a humanized anti-PTK7 monoclonal antibody conjugated with a topoisomerase I inhibitor, intended for the treatment of advanced solid tumors in adults and children. Manufactured in China and delivered intravenously in clinical trials.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Components
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of highly engineered, mission-critical components for aerospace and defense systems, including both OEM and aftermarket parts. Products are produced through precision engineering and manufacturing processes, often requiring regulatory certification and high intellectual property content.

products.name: Aircraft Interior Mechanisms and Securing Devices
products.description: Manufacture and sale of proprietary latching, securing, and interior mechanisms for aircraft, such as latches, interior securing devices, hold-open and tie rods, and edge-lighted panels. These are mechanically engineered devices produced for aircraft interiors and require specialized manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Aircraft Safety and Protection Systems
products.description: Production and sale of safety-critical systems for aircraft, including auto throttles, lap-belt airbags, seat belts, fire barriers, and water purification systems. These products are manufactured to meet stringent regulatory and safety standards and are essential for aircraft operation and passenger safety.

products.name: Aircraft Sensors and Switches
products.description: Manufacture and sale of temperature and fluid sensors and switches for aerospace applications, produced through precision engineering and subject to regulatory certification. These components are critical for monitoring and controlling aircraft systems.

products.name: Aircraft Motion and Actuation Devices
products.description: Production and sale of motion and actuation devices, including actuators, starter generators, and rate control devices, used in various aircraft systems. These are manufactured using advanced engineering and are integral to aircraft operation.

products.name: Aircraft Sealing and Insulation Solutions
products.description: Manufacture and sale of sealing solutions, polyimide washers and bushings, and fire barriers for aircraft, produced through specialized materials engineering to meet regulatory and operational requirements.

products.name: Aircraft Braking Systems
products.description: Production and sale of carbon and metallic brake discs for aircraft, manufactured using proprietary processes and materials to meet stringent performance and safety standards.

products.name: Aircraft Ice Protection and Cooling Systems
products.description: Manufacture and sale of fluid and pneumatic-based ice protection systems, high-performance fans, and cooling devices for aircraft, produced through advanced engineering and manufacturing processes.

products.name: Aircraft Lighting and Human-Machine Interface Products
products.description: Production and sale of lighting systems, bespoke lighting, and Human-Machine Interface (HMI) products for aircraft, including illuminated panels and annunciators. These are manufactured using specialized electronic and optical engineering.

products.name: Temperature-Sensitive Truckload Transportation
products.description: Provides full-load transportation services for food and consumer packaged goods requiring temperature-controlled or insulated environments, using a fleet of refrigerated trailers and tractors operated by company drivers and independent contractors. Services are delivered primarily within the United States and into/out of Mexico and Canada.

products.name: Dry Truckload Transportation
products.description: Offers full-load transportation services for dry freight (non-temperature-sensitive goods) using dry van trailers and tractors, operating regionally and nationally across the United States and into/out of Mexico and Canada.

products.name: Dedicated Transportation Services
products.description: Provides customized, contract-based transportation solutions tailored to individual customer requirements, utilizing both temperature-controlled and dry van equipment, typically under multi-year agreements within the United States.

products.name: Freight Brokerage Services
products.description: Arranges for third-party carriers to transport customer freight, including both temperature-controlled and dry van loads, managing billing, collection, and customer service responsibilities. Services are provided primarily within the United States and into/out of Mexico.

products.name: Cross-Border Transportation Services (U.S.-Mexico)
products.description: Provides door-to-door transportation services between the United States and Mexico in partnership with Mexican carriers, covering both truckload and brokerage freight, and managing cross-border logistics.

products.name: Timber Harvesting and Sales
products.description: Harvesting and sale of softwood and hardwood timber from company-owned and leased timberlands in the U.S. South and Pacific Northwest. Timber is sold to pulp, paper, wood products, and biomass facilities, as well as for export. Operations require in-person labor, regulated forestry practices, and sustainable land management.

products.name: Land-Based Solutions (Leasing for Solar, Carbon Capture, and Bioenergy)
products.description: Leasing of timberland for alternative land uses such as solar farms, wind farms, carbon capture and storage, and provision of wood fiber for bioenergy and biofuel applications. These solutions are delivered through lease agreements and require minimal incremental capital investment.

products.name: Carbon Offsets and Environmental Credits
products.description: Generation and sale of carbon offsets and other environmental credits derived from the carbon sequestered through tree growth on managed timberlands. This is a digital and regulatory-driven product line, leveraging the environmental attributes of forestry assets.

products.name: Recreational and Specialty Land Leasing
products.description: Leasing of timberland properties for recreational uses such as hunting, as well as for mineral extraction and cell tower placement. These leases provide recurring income and utilize the land's natural resources and location.

products.name: Rural and Recreational Land Sales (HBU Land Sales)
products.description: Sale of rural and recreational properties identified as having higher and better use (HBU) potential, often at premiums to timberland value. These sales involve land parcels suitable for uses beyond timber production, such as recreation or rural development.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Improved Land Sales
products.description: Development and sale of land for residential, commercial, and industrial purposes, including properties with site improvements such as infrastructure, roadways, and utilities. This involves in-house development capabilities and selective investments to enhance land value.

products.name: Unimproved Land Sales and Timberland Dispositions
products.description: Sale of unimproved development properties, non-strategic or less productive timberland, and large timberland assets. These transactions optimize the portfolio and may be executed in response to market opportunities or unsolicited offers.

products.name: Conservation Easements and Development Rights Sales
products.description: Sale of conservation easements and development rights that preclude future development while retaining rights to grow and harvest timber. These transactions are typically with conservation-oriented buyers and support environmental stewardship.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Development, production, and sale of natural gas extracted from unconventional formations in the Appalachian Basin, primarily using horizontal drilling and advanced fracture stimulation technologies. The product is delivered via pipelines to various domestic and international end markets.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction, processing, and sale of natural gas liquids (including ethane, propane, butane, isobutane, and natural gasoline) separated from liquids-rich natural gas through cryogenic processing and fractionation facilities. NGLs are delivered to various markets via pipelines and other infrastructure.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of crude oil extracted from oil-bearing formations in the Appalachian Basin, delivered to market via pipelines and other transportation infrastructure. Oil is produced alongside natural gas and NGLs using horizontal drilling and advanced completion techniques.

products.name: Marketing of Excess Firm Transportation Capacity
products.description: Sale or subletting of excess firm transportation capacity on pipelines to third parties, leveraging long-term transportation contracts to optimize utilization and offset minimum commitment fees. This is a service provided to external customers when capacity is not fully used for internal production.

products.name: Obesity and Cardiometabolic Antibody Therapeutics
products.description: Next-generation, AI-guided monoclonal and bispecific antibody drugs targeting genetically validated pathways (e.g., Activin E, myostatin, Activin A, amylin receptor) for obesity, muscle preservation, and cardiometabolic diseases. These are biologic drugs produced via mammalian cell expression and advanced through preclinical and clinical development for subcutaneous administration.

products.name: Immuno-Oncology Antibody Therapeutics
products.description: Preclinical monoclonal and bispecific antibody drugs for cancer treatment, including anti-CD25, TROP-2 x CD3 bispecifics, anti-MUC16, anti-EGFRvIII, and anti-CCR8 antibodies. These biologics are designed using AI-enabled epitope steering and mammalian display technologies to enhance tumor targeting, immune modulation, and safety profiles.

products.name: AI Drug Discovery Platform (Out-Licensing and Partnerships)
products.description: Proprietary AI and machine learning platform for antibody discovery and optimization, including epitope steering, StableHu, EngageTx, and ShieldTx technologies. The platform is offered to external partners via strategic collaborations and out-licensing for applications in immunology, inflammation, pain, and vaccines, enabling rapid biologic drug discovery and development.

products.name: Vaccine Candidates (Partnering/Out-Licensing)
products.description: Preclinical vaccine candidates for infectious diseases (e.g., influenza, anthrax, plague, HPV, trypanosomiasis, malaria, COVID-19), developed using proprietary biologic expression and AI-guided design technologies. These are available for out-licensing or partnering rather than in-house commercialization.

products.name: Private Markets Investment Solutions
products.description: Customized investment solutions across private equity, infrastructure, private debt, and real estate, delivered via separately managed accounts (SMAs) and focused commingled funds. These solutions involve portfolio construction, manager selection, and ongoing asset management, requiring significant financial capital, research, and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Advisory and Data Services
products.description: Advisory services including portfolio construction, due diligence, investment recommendations, portfolio reviews, strategic planning, and licensed access to proprietary data and technology platforms. Delivered by investment professionals and supported by proprietary databases and software, these services are provided on a recurring or project basis to institutional clients.

products.name: Portfolio Analytics and Reporting Services
products.description: Provision of tailored portfolio analytics and reporting packages, including performance benchmarking, compliance, administrative, and tax capabilities, primarily through proprietary software platforms such as SPI Reporting. These digital services facilitate ongoing monitoring and analysis of private markets portfolios for clients.

products.name: Proprietary Data and Technology Platform Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary data and technology platforms, including SPI Research (private markets intelligence database), SPI Reporting (performance monitoring software), and other analytical tools. These digital products are licensed to clients for direct access, supporting investment decision-making and portfolio management.

products.name: Private Wealth Investment Products
products.description: Private markets investment products tailored for high-net-worth and mass affluent individuals, including registered funds and global distribution of institutional funds. These products are structured to meet regulatory and liquidity requirements for individual investors and are distributed through financial advisors and wealth managers.

products.name: Ethylene
products.description: Ethylene is produced at three large-scale facilities using primarily ethane as feedstock, involving complex physical manufacturing and regulated infrastructure. It is delivered via pipeline or exchange to customers, primarily under long-term contracts.

products.name: Ethylene Co-Products (Propylene, Crude Butadiene, Pyrolysis Gasoline, Hydrogen)
products.description: Co-products are generated as byproducts of the ethylene manufacturing process and are sold to external customers. Production requires large-scale chemical processing and separation technologies.

products.name: Ethylene Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: OpCo operates a regulated 200-mile common carrier ethylene pipeline, providing transportation services for ethylene between major chemical hubs. This service is subject to state rate regulation and involves significant physical infrastructure.

products.name: Electric Aircraft
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells high-performance electric aircraft, including fixed-wing (CTOL), vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL), and military variants, produced at a dedicated assembly facility and delivered to commercial, medical, defense, and passenger operators.

products.name: Electric Propulsion Systems (Motors)
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells proprietary electric propulsion systems (motors) for use in its own aircraft and as a merchant supplier to other aerospace and defense OEMs, with products certified for aviation applications.

products.name: Aviation Battery Packs and Energy Storage Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells proprietary modular battery packs and energy storage systems for electric aircraft, both for initial installation and as recurring aftermarket replacements, using in-house assembly and safety testing facilities.

products.name: Flight Control Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells proprietary fly-by-wire flight control computers and systems for use in its own aircraft and as components to other aircraft manufacturers, providing triplex redundancy and supporting autonomous operation.

products.name: Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and Charging Infrastructure
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells ground support equipment including stationary and mobile electric aircraft chargers (Charge Cube, Mini Cube), thermal management systems, and related infrastructure, installed at airports and vertiports globally for use by multiple operators.

products.name: Aftermarket Services and Support
products.description: Provides aftermarket services for its aircraft and components, including battery replacements, maintenance, parts, and training, delivered through direct programs and planned certified repair stations.

products.name: Digital Fleet and Operations Management Platform (BETA Operate)
products.description: Develops and sells a digital platform for real-time data access, operational optimization, predictive maintenance, and regulatory compliance for electric aircraft fleets and charging infrastructure, delivered as modular software.

products.name: Hybrid Electric Turbogenerators (in partnership with GE Aerospace)
products.description: Co-develops and plans to sell hybrid electric turbogenerator propulsion systems for defense and civil aviation applications, integrating advanced hybrid technology to enhance range and payload.

products.name: Aircraft Electrical Power and Motion Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures advanced electrical power generation, distribution, and seat motion systems for commercial, military, and general aviation aircraft. These systems require specialized engineering, manufacturing, and compliance with aviation regulations.

products.name: Aircraft Lighting and Safety Systems
products.description: Produces lighting and safety systems for aircraft, including interior and exterior lighting solutions. These products are physically manufactured and must meet stringent aviation safety standards.

products.name: Avionics Products
products.description: Develops and manufactures avionics products for aircraft, involving electronic systems used in aviation for communication, navigation, and system management. These are highly regulated and require advanced engineering and manufacturing.

products.name: Aircraft Structures
products.description: Designs and manufactures structural components for aircraft, requiring precision manufacturing and compliance with aerospace standards. Delivered as physical products to OEMs and suppliers.

products.name: Systems Certification Services
products.description: Provides systems certification services, including FAA Organization Designation Authorization (ODA) services, to ensure aircraft systems meet regulatory requirements. Delivered as professional services to OEMs and operators.

products.name: Automated Test Systems
products.description: Designs, develops, manufactures, and maintains automated test systems for aerospace, defense, communications, and mass transit industries. These are complex, custom-engineered systems delivered as physical products and ongoing support services.

products.name: Training and Simulation Devices
products.description: Develops and manufactures training and simulation devices for commercial and military applications, requiring specialized engineering and integration of hardware and software for realistic simulation environments.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Production and Export
products.description: Production of LNG from natural gas at the Sabine Pass LNG Terminal using large-scale liquefaction trains, with LNG stored on-site and exported globally via marine berths. This is a capital-intensive, highly regulated, physical manufacturing and logistics operation.

products.name: Regasification and LNG Storage Services
products.description: Provision of regasification capacity and LNG storage at the Sabine Pass LNG Terminal, including long-term terminal use agreements (TUAs) with third parties. This involves operating large-scale storage tanks and vaporizers to convert LNG back to natural gas for delivery via pipeline.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: Operation of the Creole Trail Pipeline, a 94-mile natural gas pipeline interconnecting the Sabine Pass LNG Terminal with major interstate and intrastate pipelines, providing transportation of natural gas feedstock to the terminal. This is a regulated, physical infrastructure service.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial HVAC Systems
products.description: Highly configurable heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, including rooftop units, air handling units, condensing units, makeup air units, energy recovery units, and geothermal/water-source heat pumps, manufactured using sheet metal fabrication, component assembly, and rigorous end-of-line testing for commercial and industrial buildings.

products.name: Data Center Cooling Solutions
products.description: Custom-engineered thermal management and air handling solutions for hyperscale and high-density data centers, including direct evaporative coolers, fan coil walls, computer room air handling units, packaged air handling systems, liquid cooling systems (Coolant Distribution Units), and water-free free cooling chillers, manufactured to customer specifications for reliability and efficiency.

products.name: Cleanroom and Environmental Control Solutions
products.description: Custom-engineered cleanroom products and environmental control systems for biopharmaceutical, semiconductor, medical, and agricultural sectors, including modular cleanroom environments, fan filter units, filtered ceiling grids, pressurized plenums, and integrated control platforms, manufactured for precise environmental regulation in critical manufacturing and research processes.

products.name: HVAC Controls Solutions
products.description: Design and manufacture of high-performance, factory-tested controls systems for HVAC equipment, including proprietary controllers, integration with building automation, and custom controls for both AAON and third-party HVAC products, produced using advanced electronics prototyping and software development.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Service
products.description: Sale of replacement parts and provision of maintenance and warranty services for installed HVAC and cooling systems, delivered through retail part stores, online channels, and a network of factory and representative service organizations.

products.name: Heating and Cooling Coils
products.description: Engineering and manufacturing of semi-custom and custom heating and cooling coils for use in HVAC systems, produced at dedicated coil manufacturing facilities and supplied to both internal and external customers.

products.name: Spanish-Language Television Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of one of the largest groups of Spanish-language television stations in the U.S., distributing content via network affiliations (Univision, UniMás, WAPA Orlando, Altavision) and locally produced news, monetized through advertising and retransmission fees. Requires FCC-licensed spectrum, physical broadcast infrastructure, and in-person production teams.

products.name: English-Language Television Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of English-language television stations in select high-density Latino markets, broadcasting network programming (FOX, NBC, CW) and local news, monetized through advertising and retransmission fees. Requires physical broadcast infrastructure and local production teams.

products.name: Radio Broadcasting (Spanish-Language and Bilingual)
products.description: Operation of 44 radio stations targeting Latino audiences with various music and talk formats, including network and local programming, and monetized through local and national advertising. Requires FCC-licensed spectrum, physical radio infrastructure, and in-person talent.

products.name: Network Audio Advertising
products.description: National audio advertising network providing advertisers access to Latino audiences via owned and partner radio stations, including exclusive sports broadcasts (FIFA World Cup, NFL) and syndicated programming. Delivered through broadcast and digital channels, requiring content rights and network sales infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Marketing Services (U.S. Local)
products.description: Provision of digital marketing services for businesses targeting Latino consumers, including campaign planning, digital audio, video, social media, branded content, paid search, email, and display advertising. Delivered by digital media experts using proprietary and third-party platforms.

products.name: Programmatic Advertising Platform (Smadex)
products.description: Proprietary demand-side platform (DSP) offering global programmatic advertising solutions to mobile app developers, specializing in performance-based user acquisition, retargeting, and Connected TV campaigns. Delivered via cloud-based infrastructure and proprietary AI algorithms.

products.name: Performance-Based Digital Marketing Agency (Adwake)
products.description: Performance-based digital marketing agency serving mobile app developers globally, using third-party advertising technologies to acquire users on a cost-per-action basis, and aggregating traffic from diverse sources. Delivered as a managed service with plans to launch an in-app offerwall product.

products.name: Retransmission Consent and Spectrum Leasing
products.description: Monetization of broadcast spectrum through retransmission consent fees from cable, satellite, and internet distributors, and leasing of excess spectrum capacity to other broadcasters or for new content initiatives. Requires regulatory compliance and negotiation with distributors.

products.name: Off-the-shelf, iPSC-derived CAR T-cell Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Cellular immunotherapies manufactured from engineered induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), differentiated into T-cells and engineered with chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) to target B-cell mediated autoimmune diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus, systemic sclerosis, anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody-associated vasculitis, and idiopathic inflammatory myositis. These therapies are produced at scale in GMP facilities and delivered as off-the-shelf, on-demand treatments.

products.name: Off-the-shelf, iPSC-derived CAR T-cell Therapies for Cancer (Hematologic Malignancies and Solid Tumors)
products.description: Cellular immunotherapies manufactured from engineered iPSCs, differentiated into T-cells and engineered with CARs to target cancer cells, including both hematologic malignancies (e.g., B-cell lymphoma, leukemia) and solid tumors (e.g., HER2-positive cancers, MICA/B-expressing tumors). These products are mass-produced, uniform, and available off-the-shelf for clinical use.

products.name: Off-the-shelf, iPSC-derived CAR NK Cell Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases and Cancer
products.description: Cellular immunotherapies manufactured from engineered iPSCs, differentiated into natural killer (NK) cells and engineered with CARs and other synthetic controls, designed to target B-cell mediated autoimmune diseases and cancers. These therapies are produced at scale and delivered as off-the-shelf products, with features to enhance safety and efficacy, including the ability to combine with monoclonal antibody therapies.

products.name: Strategic Partnerships for iPSC-derived Cell Therapy Development
products.description: Collaborative research, development, and co-commercialization of iPSC-derived CAR T-cell and CAR NK cell product candidates with pharmaceutical partners (e.g., Ono Pharmaceutical) for the treatment of solid tumors, leveraging proprietary iPSC platform technology and manufacturing expertise. Revenue is generated through milestone payments, research funding, and profit-sharing arrangements.

products.name: Accordion Pill Drug Delivery Platform
products.description: A proprietary oral drug delivery system designed to improve the efficacy and safety of existing drugs and drugs in development by utilizing efficient gastric retention and specific release mechanisms. The platform is physically manufactured using pharmaceutical-grade, biodegradable polymeric films, folded into an accordion shape and placed inside a capsule, and is offered to pharmaceutical partners for custom drug development and licensing.

products.name: AP-CD/LD (Accordion Pill Carbidopa/Levodopa)
products.description: A proprietary oral formulation of Carbidopa and Levodopa for the treatment of Parkinson’s disease symptoms, utilizing the Accordion Pill platform to provide more stable plasma levels and improved symptom control. Manufactured at commercial scale in partnership with third-party manufacturers.

products.name: AP-Cannabinoids (Accordion Pill Cannabinoids)
products.description: Oral formulations of cannabinoids (CBD and THC) for the treatment of various pain indications, using the Accordion Pill platform to extend absorption and improve therapeutic effect. Developed through clinical trials and research collaborations.

products.name: Custom Accordion Pill Formulation Services for Pharmaceutical Partners
products.description: Research collaborations and feasibility agreements to develop custom-designed Accordion Pill formulations for proprietary compounds of pharmaceutical partners, including for rare disease indications and improved delivery of poorly soluble or narrow absorption window drugs. Delivered as contract research and development services.

products.name: Private Equity Solutions
products.description: Structuring, managing, and monitoring portfolios of private equity investments, including primary funds, secondaries, direct investments, and co-investments, primarily in the middle and lower-middle markets in North America and Europe. Delivered through commingled funds and customized separate accounts, requiring financial capital, investment expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Venture Capital Solutions
products.description: Providing access to venture capital investments through fund-of-funds, direct investments, and co-investments, targeting high-performing, access-constrained opportunities in North America. Delivered via commingled funds and separate accounts, leveraging strategic partnerships and industry relationships.

products.name: Private Credit Solutions
products.description: Offering debt investments and loans to lower-middle market companies, funds, and projects, including impact investments in areas such as renewable energy, historic building renovation, and underserved communities. Delivered through various fund vehicles and separate accounts, requiring financial structuring and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Impact Investing Solutions
products.description: Investing in projects and businesses with social or environmental impact, such as renewable energy, historic building renovations, and affordable housing, primarily through private credit and equity vehicles. Requires specialized investment expertise and compliance with impact and ESG frameworks.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Production and sale of diesel, vacuum gas oil (VGO), naphtha, and liquid paving asphalt through physical refining of crude oil at the Eagle Springs Refinery. Products are manufactured using distillation, catalytic cracking, hydrotreating, and reforming units, and delivered to wholesale, bulk, and retail customers.

products.name: Recycled Asphalt Shingle Products
products.description: Recycling of waste asphalt shingles using proprietary ECOSolv technology to produce liquid asphalt cement, shingle granules, sand aggregate, limestone, and fiberglass for sale to asphalt paving companies and shingle manufacturers. The process involves mechanical and solvent-based separation in modular, scalable facilities.

products.name: Heavy Oil and Bitumen from Oil Sands
products.description: Extraction and sale of heavy oil and bitumen from mined oil sands deposits at the PR Spring Facility using proprietary solvent-based ECOSolv process. The process involves surface mining, crushing, solvent extraction, and mechanical separation to produce heavy oil for refining and asphalt paving aggregate.

products.name: Metalworking Products
products.description: A broad range of metalworking products including cutting tools, abrasives, machining fluids, measuring instruments, machinery and accessories, and tooling components, distributed through physical inventory and E-commerce channels. These products are sourced from third-party manufacturers and MSC exclusive brands, requiring physical warehousing and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) Products
products.description: A comprehensive selection of MRO products such as fasteners, flat stock, raw materials, hand and power tools, safety and janitorial supplies, plumbing supplies, materials handling products, power transmission components, and electrical supplies, distributed via physical and digital channels. These products are sourced, stocked, and shipped using MSC's logistics network.

products.name: Inventory Management Solutions
products.description: A suite of inventory management services including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI), Customer Managed Inventory (CMI), vending solutions, tool crib control, and in-plant solutions, delivered through a combination of proprietary digital platforms, physical equipment (such as vending machines), and on-site support. These solutions are tailored to customer needs and integrate with customer procurement systems.

products.name: E-commerce and Digital Procurement Platforms
products.description: Online platforms, primarily the MSC website and integrated eProcurement solutions, offering customers access to a searchable catalog of approximately 2.5 million SKUs, real-time inventory, electronic ordering, workflow management, and customized reporting. These platforms are digital-only and interface with customer purchasing systems.

products.name: Class C Consumables
products.description: Distribution and management of low-cost, high-volume consumable items (such as fasteners, hardware, and components) for manufacturing and industrial customers, often bundled with inventory management services like VMI. These are sourced from suppliers and delivered through MSC's logistics and digital platforms.

products.name: Tool Regrinding and Manufacturing Services
products.description: Specialized services for regrinding and manufacturing of tools, scaled through acquisitions and delivered via dedicated facilities. These services require physical manufacturing locations and skilled labor.

products.name: Technical Support and Productivity Optimization Services
products.description: On-site and remote technical support, process optimization, and productivity improvement services for manufacturing customers, delivered by specialized teams using proprietary tools and data analysis. These services are provided by human experts and supported by digital tools such as Ap Op and MSC MillMax.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination, acquisition, financing, and management of commercial mortgage loans (including first mortgages, subordinated mortgages, mezzanine loans, and construction/rehabilitation loans) and related debt investments, primarily secured by commercial properties. Delivered through direct lending and investment activities, requiring significant financial capital and real estate underwriting expertise.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination, acquisition, financing, and management of non-agency residential mortgage loans and residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS), primarily secured by residential properties. Delivered through direct lending and investment, requiring financial capital and mortgage underwriting.

products.name: Infrastructure Lending
products.description: Origination, acquisition, financing, and management of infrastructure debt investments, including senior secured project finance loans and investment securities secured by power generation and oil & gas assets. Delivered through direct lending and investment, requiring specialized financial structuring and sector expertise.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CMBS) and Related Investments
products.description: Acquisition and management of commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS), including investment grade, below investment grade, and unrated tranches, as well as related debt and equity interests. Delivered through capital markets transactions and investment management, requiring financial analysis and securitization expertise.

products.name: Equity Ownership in Commercial Real Estate Properties
products.description: Acquisition and management of equity interests in stabilized and to-be-stabilized commercial real estate properties, including multifamily, medical office, and net lease properties. Delivered through direct property investment and asset management, requiring real estate operations and leasing expertise.

products.name: Net Lease Property Investments
products.description: Acquisition and management of commercial properties subject to net leases (including triple net leases), where tenants pay most operating costs. Delivered through property acquisition and leasing, requiring real estate investment and lease structuring expertise.

products.name: Loan Servicing and Special Servicing
products.description: Servicing and special servicing of commercial real estate loans, including managing and working out problem assets and acting as special servicer for CMBS trusts. Delivered through asset management and loan workout operations, requiring regulatory compliance and real estate expertise.

products.name: Conduit Loan Origination for Securitization
products.description: Origination of conduit commercial mortgage loans for the primary purpose of selling these loans into securitization transactions. Delivered through loan origination and capital markets activities, requiring underwriting and securitization expertise.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including multifamily, office, industrial, retail, medical, hospitality, and land development properties. These loans are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced by the bank, requiring in-person evaluation, collateral appraisal, and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans and lines of credit to businesses and municipalities for purposes such as working capital, equipment acquisition, and capital improvements. These loans are typically secured by business assets and require financial analysis and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Commercial Equipment Financing
products.description: Financing solutions for business and municipal customers to acquire equipment, including direct loans, finance leases, and municipal leases. Delivered through a specialized subsidiary, this involves underwriting, collateralization, and servicing of equipment-backed loans and leases.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, including fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages, as well as home equity loans and lines of credit. These are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced, with collateral secured by residential real estate.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans such as auto loans (primarily indirect through dealerships), personal loans, lines of credit, and loans secured by savings or certificates of deposit. These are underwritten based on creditworthiness and collateral, and delivered through both direct and indirect channels.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offering a range of deposit accounts to individuals, businesses, and municipalities, including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and IRAs. These are delivered through physical branches, digital platforms, and remote channels, and are a primary funding source for the bank.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provision of online and mobile banking platforms enabling customers to access accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, deposit checks remotely, and open accounts digitally. Delivered via proprietary digital channels and supported by a Virtual Branch for remote assistance.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offering fiduciary and investment services, including investment management, estate administration, trustee services, retirement plan services, and custodial accounts. Delivered through a dedicated trust department and supported by professional staff, these services require regulatory compliance and personalized management.

products.name: Brokerage and Investment Products
products.description: Through a third-party broker-dealer relationship, the bank offers securities brokerage, annuity sales, and access to investment products such as stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and insurance products. These are delivered via in-branch representatives and digital channels.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Provision of cash management solutions for business customers, including ACH payments, remote and mobile deposit capture, lockbox services, wire transfers, payroll, merchant services, fraud prevention, and specialized business cards. Delivered through both digital and in-person channels, these services support business operational needs.

products.name: Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of diversified retail and mixed-use properties to external tenants, involving property management and tenant agreements. Delivery requires ownership and management of physical real estate assets.

products.name: Real Estate Sales
products.description: Sale of retail and mixed-use properties and land to external buyers, as part of an asset monetization strategy. Delivery involves transaction management and transfer of physical property ownership.

products.name: Semiconductor Wafer Fabrication Equipment
products.description: A comprehensive portfolio of equipment used in the manufacturing of semiconductor chips, including systems for patterning, transistor and interconnect fabrication, process control, metrology, inspection, review, and advanced packaging. These are physically manufactured, highly engineered capital equipment products delivered to semiconductor fabrication plants.

products.name: Semiconductor Equipment Services and Spares
products.description: A suite of services, spare parts, and upgrades for installed semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including transactional and subscription service products, delivered through a global network of field engineers and distribution systems. This includes maintenance, optimization, and productivity enhancement for customer fabs.

products.name: Factory Automation Software for Semiconductor Manufacturing
products.description: Software solutions for automating and optimizing semiconductor fabrication plant operations, including productivity and performance management, delivered digitally and supported by field engineers.

products.name: Display Manufacturing Equipment
products.description: Manufacturing equipment for the display industry, used in the production of flat panel displays and related products. These are physically manufactured capital equipment products sold to display manufacturers.

products.name: Enteral Feeding Solutions
products.description: Manufactured medical devices including MIC-KEY enteral feeding tubes and Corpak patient feeding solutions, designed to provide nutrition to patients from hospital to home. Products are produced in company-owned facilities and distributed globally to healthcare providers.

products.name: Neonatal and Pediatric Feeding Solutions
products.description: Manufactured medical devices such as NeoMed neonatal and pediatric feeding solutions and Nexus TKO anti-reflux needleless connectors, focused on feeding and vascular access for neonatal and pediatric patients. Products are produced in company facilities and distributed to hospitals and care centers.

products.name: Surgical Pain and Recovery Products
products.description: Manufactured non-opioid pain management devices including ON-Q and ambIT surgical pain pumps and Game Ready cold and compression therapy systems, used to manage pain and aid recovery after surgery. Products are produced in company facilities and sold to healthcare providers.

products.name: Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) Solutions
products.description: Manufactured minimally invasive pain-relieving medical devices, including COOLIEF pain therapy products and Trident and ESENTEC RFA products, used to treat chronic pain conditions. Products are produced in company facilities and distributed to healthcare providers.

products.name: Vascular Access Devices
products.description: Manufactured medical devices for vascular access, including products acquired through the Nexus acquisition, designed to facilitate safe and effective vascular access in clinical settings. Products are produced in company facilities and distributed to hospitals and care centers.

products.name: Cardiovascular Gene Therapies
products.description: Gene therapy products targeting rare inherited cardiovascular diseases, including Danon disease, Plakophilin-2 Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy (PKP2-ACM), and BAG3 Dilated Cardiomyopathy (BAG3-DCM). These therapies are developed using adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors and are administered as single intravenous infusions, manufactured in-house under cGMP conditions.

products.name: Hematology Gene Therapies
products.description: Gene therapy products for rare inherited blood disorders, including Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiency-I (LAD-I), Fanconi Anemia (FA), and Pyruvate Kinase Deficiency (PKD). These therapies use autologous hematopoietic stem cells genetically modified with lentiviral vectors to deliver functional copies of disease-causing genes, manufactured via partnerships and in-house capabilities.

products.name: Coal Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of bituminous coal, including thermal and metallurgical grades, from underground mining complexes in the Illinois Basin and Appalachia, delivered to domestic utilities, industrial users, and international customers. Operations require physical mining, processing, and regulated transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Coal Mineral Leasing and Royalties
products.description: Leasing of coal mineral reserves and resources to internal and third-party mining operations, generating royalty income based on production or sales. Involves ownership or control of mineral rights and regulated lease agreements.

products.name: Oil & Gas Mineral Leasing and Royalties
products.description: Leasing of oil & gas mineral interests to operators in major U.S. basins, generating royalty income from production without bearing operating or capital costs. Involves acquisition, management, and marketing of mineral rights for lease.

products.name: Industrial, Mining, and Technology Products and Services (Matrix Group)
products.description: Development and sale of industrial, mining, and technology products and services, including data networks, communication and tracking systems, mining proximity detection, collision avoidance systems, and analytics software, delivered to mining and industrial customers worldwide. Requires engineering, manufacturing, and digital technology capabilities.

products.name: Cryptocurrency Mining and Hosting (Bitiki)
products.description: Operation of bitcoin mining facilities and hosting of third-party crypto-miners for a fee, utilizing specialized computing hardware and energy infrastructure. Revenue is generated from mined cryptocurrency and hosting services.

products.name: Securities Brokerage Services
products.description: Comprehensive securities brokerage services for individuals, businesses, and institutions, including trading of equities, bonds, derivatives, mutual funds, and margin lending, delivered via digital platforms (Tradernet, SuperApp) and physical offices across multiple countries.

products.name: Investment Banking Services
products.description: Investment banking services including underwriting, M&A advisory, capital markets advisory, and market making, provided by professionals in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and the United States, leveraging both digital and in-person expertise.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full suite of retail and commercial banking products including deposits, multi-currency payment cards, consumer and SME loans, money transfers, and correspondent accounts, primarily delivered digitally via the Freedom SuperApp and supported by a focused physical branch network.

products.name: Life and General Insurance Services
products.description: Life and general insurance products including life, health, annuity, accident, property, automobile, civil liability, and travel insurance, distributed digitally and through physical offices, with rapid online policy issuance and management.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Digital payment processing solutions including electronic money issuance, acceptance, and processing, integrated into the Freedom SuperApp and offered to individuals and merchants, supporting seamless transactions and merchant acquiring.

products.name: E-commerce and Online Marketplace Services
products.description: Online retail trade and e-commerce services, including a lifestyle marketplace embedded in the SuperApp, offering products such as grocery delivery, on-demand home services, and merchant solutions for SMEs to create online stores and manage sales.

products.name: Entertainment and Travel Ticketing Services
products.description: Online aggregation and sale of entertainment (cinema, concerts) and travel (air and railway) tickets, delivered through digital platforms and integrated into the SuperApp lifestyle marketplace.

products.name: Telecommunications Services
products.description: Telecommunications services including internet connectivity, fixed wireless access, WiFi, OTT streaming, IPTV, and traffic transit, provided through Freedom Telecom in Kazakhstan, with plans for bundled offerings and future mobile operator capabilities.

products.name: Media and Streaming Services
products.description: Digital media and streaming services offering access to TV shows, movies, documentaries, and exclusive content, developed for Kazakhstan and Central Asia via Freedom Media LLP, with a focus on regional content and digital delivery.
